description: Configures the Nutanix Cloud Clusters (NC2) Terraform provider. All authentication inputs are sensitive and resolved per FR-001a (block > env > credentials_file). TLS verification is mandatory per FR-003b.

api_key.description: MyNutanix API key. May also be supplied via the NC2_API_KEY environment variable or via the credentials_file. The provider block takes precedence (FR-001a).

key_id.description: MyNutanix API key ID. Used as the JWT `kid` header and as the HMAC body per the NC2 JWT signing recipe. May be supplied via NC2_KEY_ID or credentials_file (FR-001a).

nc2_mapping.request: auth.key_id (JWT kid header + HMAC body input)

issuer.description: Issuer UUID used in the JWT `iss` claim (FR-001). May be supplied via NC2_ISSUER or credentials_file (FR-001a).

credentials_file.description: Path to a TOML/INI credentials file. Defaults to ~/.nc2/credentials when not set. Read at provider Configure() time; precedence is below block and env vars (FR-001a).

profile.description: Profile name to select within the credentials_file (default profile name: `default`). May also be supplied via the NC2_PROFILE environment variable.

base_url.description: Override for the NC2 API base URL. Defaults to the public NC2 endpoint. Set this only for proxied or test environments (FR-003a).

ca_bundle.description: Path to a PEM file containing additional trusted root CAs. Contents are APPENDED to (not replacing) the OS trust store at startup. The provider fails plan-time validation if the file is unreadable or not valid PEM (FR-003b). There is NO insecure_skip_verify option in any build.

task_poll_interval_seconds.description: Interval at which the provider polls NC2 task status during async operations (FR-003).

task_max_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum total time the provider will poll a single NC2 task before returning a timeout error referencing the task ID (FR-003).

behavioral_invariants.description: When the same credential attribute is supplied by more than one source AND values differ, the provider MUST emit a non-fatal warning naming both sources and use the higher-precedence value.
The provider binary MUST NOT import any client library for external secret managers. Enforced by a CI import-graph check.
All four credential attributes (api_key, key_id, issuer, derived JWT) MUST be redacted in plan output, apply output, persisted state, and debug logs at every verbosity level.
No code path may construct an http.Client with InsecureSkipVerify=true. Enforced by FR-003c unit test.
Every outbound NC2 HTTP call must emit exactly one tflog.Info audit record with the FR-020a field set.
